function: Conditional diffusion model synthesizing position-specific MIMO channels to augment scarce channel data, evaluated on CSI feedback compression and beam alignment (pp. 2-4, 10-13).
system: Narrowband MIMO at 28 GHz: 32x1 ULA BS, 4x1 ULA UE (QuaDRiGa); 4x4 UPA BS, 2x2 UPA UE (DeepMIMO); no RIS (pp. 8, 12).
method: Conditional DDIM with compact U-net (62k parameters), trained by denoising score matching on position-channel pairs; downstream CRNet and beam-alignment networks trained on augmented data (pp. 4-7, 10-12).
data_channel: QuaDRiGa Berlin urban macro LOS for generation and CSI compression; DeepMIMO outdoor blockage for beam alignment; 100 to 10,000 position-channel training pairs (pp. 7-8, 12-13).
test_conditions: Exp ID: train and test within 100 m; Exp OOD: train within 100 m, test at 100-200 m (p. 7); downstream tests on held-out channels (pp. 11, 13).
baselines: Gaussian-noise augmentation, ChannelGAN (cGAN variant), one-shot U-net, no-DFT cDDIM and unaugmented data; for beams DFT+EGC, genie DFT, exhaustive search, MRC+MRT bound (pp. 8, 10, 12).
metrics: Peak beam-index match probability (CDF of index difference); NMSE of CRNet CSI reconstruction; average SNR of synthesized beams (pp. 9-13).
complexity: Table I: 62k parameters for cDDIM vs 10k for ChannelGAN; training O(E N_train U), inference O(T N_aug U), with 256 sampling steps (pp. 7-8).
q1_support: p. 3: "We use the QuaDRiGa [41] and DeepMIMO [13] datasets in this experiment"; Berlin urban macro LOS (p. 7) and an outdoor blockage scenario (p. 13).
q2_support: p. 7: "The training set is collected from a 100 m radius, while the test set is collected from a donut-shaped region spanning 100 m to 200 m" (Exp OOD, same QuaDRiGa scenario).
q3_support: p. 10: "We consider (i) adding Gaussian noise and (ii) ChannelGAN [20] as baseline methods", compared on NMSE (p. 11) and beam SNR (p. 13).
q4_support: p. 7: "Table I compares both the parameter count and time complexity of our cDDIM-based approach"; 62k parameters, inference O(T x N_aug x U).
q5_support: p. 13: "we use the DeepMIMO dataset [13]", a public ray-tracing channel dataset; the paper gives no code or data link of its own.
notes: Area 2 because the learned function is channel synthesis (named in area 2); the downstream tasks are CSI compression (area 2) and beam alignment (area 3), and the paper reports NMSE and generation quality (pp. 9-13). q1: QuaDRiGa and DeepMIMO, both named in the protocol. q2 rests on the Exp OOD test region (100-200 m) versus the 0-100 m training region of the same QuaDRiGa scenario (p. 7); reviewer to confirm that a distance-range shift counts as a new condition. q5 rests on DeepMIMO being a public dataset (p. 13); no code link appears.
